auth.invite_key_hint: The key you got from the administrator, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-…

password.rules: At least 12 characters and hard to guess: no names, dates or simple sequences.

dashboard.title: My configs
dashboard.banner_blocked: Your access is blocked by the administrator. Configs do not work.
dashboard.banner_expired: Your access period has ended. Ask the administrator to extend it.
dashboard.config_name_hint: The config file and the connection in the AmneziaVPN app get this name.
dashboard.config_name_optional: Optional. Without a name the config is called "server protocol".
dashboard.delete_config: Delete config "{{name}}"? It stops working and cannot be restored.
dashboard.block_config: Block config "{{name}}"? You can unblock it later.

share.title: Config "{{name}}"
share.qr: QR code for the AmneziaVPN app
share.how: Paste the key into the AmneziaVPN app or scan the QR code.
share.unavailable: This config was imported from the server and the panel has no keys for it. It cannot be issued again — create a new one.
share.how_link: Open the link on your device or scan the QR code.

file.xray_json: Xray config in JSON format (as in AmneziaVPN)

account.title: Account
account.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

admin.invite_once: The key is shown only once. Copy it and send it to the user — it cannot be shown again, only reissued.
admin.reissue_confirm: The old key will stop working. Continue?
admin.block_user: Block user "{{name}}"? All their configs stop working but are kept.
admin.delete_user: Delete user "{{name}}" and all their configs? This cannot be undone.
admin.ssh_key: SSH private key (instead of a password)
admin.host_key_changed: The server's host key changed. If the server was reinstalled, accept the new key; otherwise check that the server was not replaced.
admin.delete_server: Remove server "{{name}}" from the panel? Nothing is deleted on the server itself.
admin.orphans_hint: These clients were found on servers and were not created by the panel. They keep working. Assign them to users.
admin.reinstall_confirm: The protocol is already installed. Reinstalling creates new server keys and every config issued on it stops working. Reinstall?

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.invite_invalid: The key is invalid or already used
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least 12 characters
errors.password_too_weak: The password is too easy to guess
errors.server_unavailable: The server does not respond. Try again later.
errors.blocked_by_admin: This config was blocked by the administrator
errors.unsupported_container: This protocol is not supported on the server
errors.ssh_credentials_required: Give an SSH password or key
errors.server_unreachable: Could not connect to the server
errors.csrf: Your session is outdated. Reload the page.
errors.already_installed: The protocol is already installed on the server
errors.conflict: The data changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.server_full: The server has no room for another config. Choose another server.

load.title: Load
load.untracked_note: {{protocols}} not counted: these protocols have no per-client traffic counters.

rec.no_data: No recent load data: {{error}}. Check SSH access to the server.
rec.cpu_high: In the busiest 5% of the day CPU is above 80% (p95 {{p95}}%). Move some users to another server, close it to new configs, or upgrade the plan.
rec.memory_high: In the busiest 5% of the day memory is more than 80% used (p95 {{p95}}%). Offload the server or add memory.
rec.channel_high: In the busiest 5% of the day the channel is more than 80% used (p95 {{p95}}%). Offload the server or widen the channel.
rec.disk_full: Disk {{pct}}% full. Clean up logs and unused Docker images.
rec.clients_over: {{active}} active configs, more than the expected {{expected}}. Raise the expected number or offload the server.
rec.bandwidth_unset: Set the channel width: without it the channel does not count in the load level.
rec.bandwidth_exceeded: Peak {{peak_mbps}} Mbit/s is above the set channel width of {{width_mbps}} Mbit/s. Check the value.
rec.clients_unset: Set the expected active configs so they count in the load level.
rec.untracked_protocols: {{protocols}} client activity is not counted: these protocols have no traffic counters.
rec.room_to_grow: Low load all week: the server has room for more users.
